page.title: POTS (Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome) — RepurpOS | OpenSourceMedicine
page.description: Structured alterations and therapeutics for Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome: molecular targets, clinical biomarkers, phenotypes, and ranked drugs from Open Targets, HPO, ChEMBL, and DGIdb.
page.hero: Disease intelligence for Postural Orthostatic Tachycardia Syndrome: 124 alterations and 117 ranked therapeutics from curated public databases.

alteration_provenance.hpo: Monarch v3 association API, biolink:has_phenotype, direct=true (annotations of this MONDO class only)
alteration_provenance.clinicaltrials: outcome measures (type T) from the earlier ClinicalTrials.gov v2 query of completed studies

identifier_correction.note: MONDO has no class labelled POTS: MONDO:0001315 is labelled 'orthostatic intolerance' and carries 'postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome' and 'POTS' as exact synonyms (MONDO:0011479 is only the monogenic NET-deficiency form). UMLS C2931185 dropped (unverified).
